mode: Built-in image_gen; one generation per concept; no reference images
brief: Five high-fidelity Android TV / Google TV home-screen concepts for the independent app CAMEO, renamed from POV. One complete flat, straight-on, approximately 16:9 app screen per concept; no device frame, room, perspective, desktop chrome, cursor or phone UI. Clear readable TV-distance typography, simple line icons, generous spacing, TV safe margins and one prominent remote focus target. Original C mark and CAMEO wordmark. Navigation: Home, Movies, Shows, Anime, Library, Search, Settings. Featured fictional film: THE LAST HORIZON. Metadata: 2026 • Sci-Fi • 2h 08m. Actions: Explore and + Library. Original photorealistic artwork of a lone astronaut on a rocky coast beneath a huge planet and distant spacecraft at dusk. Continue Watching shelf with three landscape cards and thin progress bars; Discover shelf with five original posters: SILENT TIDE, AFTERLIGHT, WILD ATLAS, SKYBOUND, CITY OF ECHOES. Optional Made by Mark Mateo footer. Small concept number/name label at top right. No account data, provider connection badges, ratings, extra widgets, other branding or POV text. Concepts only; illustrative film content.

concepts.name: Glass
concepts.theme_prompt: 01 / GLASS. Original Apple TV-inspired spacious glass design. Ink-blue canvas, full-bleed hero across upper portion, cool white typography and ice-blue focus. Slim rounded translucent dark-glass left navigation rail, original CAMEO wordmark at top, seven navigation items with line icons and text. Reserve blur for navigation and a few controls, use fine pale borders and moderate corners. Elegant sans-serif hero typography at left and blue-hour astronaut coastline artwork at right. Explore focused in off-white with a blue edge; Library understated. Continue Watching and Discover below. Calm, buildable TV composition, no gaudy neon.

concepts.name: Cinema
concepts.theme_prompt: 02 / CINEMA. Luxury cinema editorial style: matte obsidian black, warm champagne accents, restrained amber cinematic art, generous TV-distance typography, almost square corners and fine ruled separators. Small ivory CAMEO wordmark upper left with original subtle C symbol. Horizontal top navigation, Home with subtle champagne underline. Broad full-width hero with large condensed elegant editorial title at left and warm amber astronaut coastline artwork predominantly right, with a strong black fade for text. Explore is the one prominent remote focus target in champagne fill and crisp ivory outline; Library understated outlined. Continue Watching in a low three-card band with slender amber progress bars. Five-card Discover shelf below. Optional Made by Mark Mateo footer. No glass sidebar or neon glow.

concepts.name: Slate
concepts.theme_prompt: 03 / SLATE. Refined regular streaming interface: matte graphite charcoal surfaces, emerald accent, clear readable sans-serif typography; no blur, glass, neon or gold. Slim permanent dark graphite left navigation with original CAMEO mark, simple white line icons and labels. Home current section indicated with understated emerald marker. Compact wide featured panel upper half, split text left and blue-hour astronaut coastline art right, strong readable graphite backdrop behind text. Explore is focused in emerald fill with crisp white outline, Library simple outlined. Content-forward Continue Watching with three wide cards and thin emerald progress bars, then five aligned posters in consistent rounded rectangles. Comfortable TV type, spacious consistent gutters and small Made by Mark Mateo footer.

concepts.name: Pearl
concepts.theme_prompt: 04 / PEARL. A genuinely light premium editorial gallery: warm ivory pearl background, dark charcoal readable text, mist and slate blue accents, delicate gray rules, subtle shadows and generous spacing. Original CAMEO mark upper left. Elegant horizontal top navigation, Home with discreet underline. Spacious split hero with left 40 percent ivory text area, large refined contemporary serif title and actions; right 60 percent framed blue-hour astronaut coastline artwork with rounded 14px corners. Keep the theme decisively light. Explore is the one clear focus target in saturated slate blue with a high-contrast double outline, Library thin gray outlined. Three wide Continue Watching cards with soft shadows and thin blue progress bars, five vivid Discover posters below. Print-like sophistication, small Made by Mark Mateo footer. No glass sidebar, neon, gold, low-contrast tiny text or noisy wallpaper.

concepts.name: Aurora
concepts.theme_prompt: 05 / AURORA. Restrained futuristic theme: midnight violet near-black background, subtle atmospheric teal-to-indigo aurora gradient at edges, bright white typography, fine cyan accents and tasteful soft depth. No cyberpunk HUD, gaming dashboard or excessive glow. Original CAMEO wordmark upper left. Floating compact horizontal rounded navigation capsule upper center, Home with discreet cyan underline. Large asymmetric panoramic hero below with soft 24px corners, left title and actions, right teal/violet blue-hour astronaut coastline artwork, strong dark fade behind text. Explore is the sole clear focus target with aqua fill, dark text and crisp cyan focus ring; Library thin outlined. Three wide Continue Watching cards with thin cyan progress, five Discover posters below. Cards have restrained floating-looking depth, hairline cool borders and modest rounding, aligned level. Small Made by Mark Mateo footer. No left navigation rail or extra widgets.
